instruction: Can you configure Baidu to be my primary search engine when I search online?

metadata.explanation: Variation 9: Change default search engine to Baidu. Uses existing get_default_search_engine getter and match_in_list metric. Evaluator accepts both 'Baidu' and '百度' (Chinese name) as valid names.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads Chrome's default search engine from preferences file (chrome.py:200-231)
Metric correctly checks if result matches expected values using match_in_list (general.py:50-57)
Expected values include both 'Baidu' and '百度' to handle internationalization
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are saved to disk
Data flow is correct: getter extracts string -> metric checks string in list
Complete coverage: instruction requires setting default search engine, evaluator verifies default search engine
State is accessible: preferences file persists settings and is readable after Chrome restart
